text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Here I go! Five... four... three... two――
(*whirrrrrr*...... *BOOM!!*)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!! Whoooooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Woooo! Awesome!! Come on, Trainer, shout 
it out too!"
choice_data_list: No, even if you tell me to shout...—

text_block_list.text:
—It is broad daylight on New Year's Day in 
the Trainer's office. The fireworks are 
simply a video being played on a tablet by 
Daring Heart and the others.
choice_data_list: New Year's Eve is already over, right...?
New Year's Eve is already over, right...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"My, you really stay calm no matter what, 
don't you? Though that is one of your best 
qualities!"

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Well, we have curfews and all~, so we 
couldn't go to any New Year's Eve events. 
We wanna party, even if it's after the 
fact!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And so, you too! It's a New Year, so let's 
get even more hyped up! Woo♪
choice_data_list:
But you're finally moving up to the 
Classic class, so—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No! Today of all days, I won't listen to 
anything serious!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: And with that... Trainer, choose now!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: High, middle, or low?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Just think of it as your vibe! Which one 
do you want?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Come on, come on, hurry up and choose!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: High, huh! Okay, in that case—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Let's get hyped up! Woooo! Dance time!"

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text: Yay~♡

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you chose "high", didn't you? 
Come on, get waaaay more hyped!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Say, “Whoa!”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes! Say, “Ho, ho, ho!”

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text:
"Look at Trainer go, gettin' it done♪" 
"Wanna MC next~?" "Sounds awesome!" "Tear 
it up, Trainer-san~!"

An unfamiliar atmosphere, an unfamiliar 
level of excitement... Yet thanks to 
Daring Heart and her friends, it turned 
out to be a really fun time.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Phew~... That was so fun!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Middle, I see. That solid choice is so 
like you! Well then, shall we get going?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haaah... It's so warm...

Where Daring Heart and the others brought 
me was a private log cabin available for 
rent. There was a fireplace right in the 
center of the room.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing! I've never seen a real 
fireplace before...! Man, this is so 
emotional.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That sounds lovely... It reminds me of the 
lodge we used to rent whenever my family 
went out for winter sports.
choice_data_list: Still... what part of that is "middle"?
Still... what part of that is "middle"?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Well, just playing it safe. I wanted to 
chill out, the way a New Year's should be.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Come now, come by the fireplace. Here... 
take a blanket too, won't you?
(Clap... clap...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Well? ...Calming, isn't it?

Listening to the soft crackling of the 
fire... I spent a relaxing, carefree time 
with Daring Heart and the others.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Phew~... That was so fun!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Low... Loooooooow....

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Okay! Speaking of 'low'—"

text_block_list.name: Zombies
text_block_list.text: U... Ooooh... Oooooooooooo...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "It must be a zombie! Kyaaaa~♪"

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaaaaaa!?!?
choice_data_list:
Why is there a zombie event for New 
Year's!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what are you talking about?! 
Zombies don't care about the seasons, do 
they? Come on, stop saying such weird 
things~!

text_block_list.name: Zombie A
text_block_list.text: Ah... Aaah...

text_block_list.name: Zombie A
text_block_list.text: —Ahhh, Happy New Yeeeaaarrr...!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, haha! What's up with this zombie? 
Happy New Year~! That's hilarious, right 
Heart?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Nooo! A weird zombie...!! Aaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
"Hearts?! ...As always, your scare points 
are totally out of whack..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Phew~... That was so fun!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but we goofed around so much, I'm 
completely wiped out...
choice_data_list: You should take it easy and get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes—is what I'd like to say, but... I have 
a New Year's party with Craft and the 
others right after this!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"You bet! So with that said... I wanna 
take a shower, so I'll be heading back 
first!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, everyone! Love you all♪

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
"...Seriously though, Heart has way too 
much energy! She's super stoic, and her 
mental game is insanely strong~."

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend C
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, she's way too cool~. —That's 
why we can't afford to lose either! Or 
something like that.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
I'd heard rumors that an amazing girl from 
that Hill Esta Academy had enrolled here.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
I mean, since we're here at Tracen 
Academy, we had pride in being amazing 
Umamusume ourselves, but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Hi! You there with the lovely barrette, 
could you tell me what the most delicious 
item on the menu is?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Your taste is absolutely the best! 
...Hey, let's be friends, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
I could tell at a single glance. That she 
was that Umamusume everyone's been talking 
about. I mean—she's super gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
I totally got that spark, thinking she was 
our true Queen~. ...Yeah, and that's 
precisely why...

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
—We're friends with that heart of hers! So 
we gotta look super stylish too, right?
choice_data_list: You really look up to Heart, don't you
You really look up to Heart, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend C
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am! Otherwise, I wouldn't be 
chasing you this hard~.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend D
text_block_list.text:
"So with that settled, Trainer! I'm 
counting on you for the heart!"

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"We've gotta start focusing on our own 
stuff soon too, so... we're counting on 
you to cheer on our behalf, too!"

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, running low on energy~?" "Hey, 
wanna go to karaoke now?" "Down~!" "How 
about you, Trainer?"
choice_data_list:
...I'll make sure everyone gets back to 
the dorm safely.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Well then, once more! Ready, set—!

text_block_list.name: Heart & Craft
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year! Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Cesario & Messiah
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year♪ Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Ehh! Then Ms. Heart, you've been playing 
since morning?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's the New Year, after all, so we 
gotta have fun to our heart's content! 
Tomorrow's a rest day anyway♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I should've done that too? Having 
fun to the fullest... Since I won't get 
much chance to after this."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—Starting this year, we're in the Classic 
Class. Which means...

text_block_list.name: Heart & Craft
text_block_list.text: The Triple Tiara begins!

text_block_list.name: Heart & Craft
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right, Craft! Our dream 
stage—the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Who will be crowned Queen? The moment of 
truth is finally here...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Both of you ran wonderfully in the 
Hanshin JF."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To be honest... I also felt like a gap was 
opening between us.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san—and Craft-san too— you're both 
running in the Fillies' Revue, correct?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—Next time, I would be honored if you 
would entertain me as well.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Wow, wow... wow! Messiah's fired up too!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's make the cherry blossoms 
bloom early with our fiery passion!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: And with that, Cesario? Care to join in?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...No. I shall take a little more time to 
hone my own legs."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—So that I can clash with everyone at the 
Oka Sho at full power.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —...Let's run!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Gah!? Craft?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let's all run! I want to run! Because, 
because—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Looking at everyone's faces, I just can't 
wait for the race anymore!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want us to compete for our Tiara— right 
now!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...That's not fair. I wanted to take the 
lead!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... What will you do, Messiah-san? 
Craft and Heart-san seem raring to go too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
On our end... it's a dream come true. Even 
so...—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It would be a waste of all the treats we 
prepared, so... why don't we continue our 
New Year's party first?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
True! I'm glad to have you two 
level-headed folks around.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's keep the party going! Our 
heated showdown can wait—until after♪
